notes.title: AMF FULL RELEASE 1.00 w/ NEW WEAPONS & SURVIVAL CAMPAIGN MODE
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We are pleased to announce the full release of ALPHA MIKE FOXTROT VR today, we thank everyone for their feedback and reviews for helping us to get this far. It has been a wonderful journey with you all!

For today's full release we will be offering a limited time launch discount starting at 9AM PST. If you or your friends are looking to pickup AMF VR, now would be a great time!

With 1.00 release of the game we will be providing 3 new weapons, a new map (Wasteland) and a brand new Survival Campaign mode!

[b]PLEASE RELOAD STEAM AND DOWNLOAD THE LATEST AMF UPDATE BEFORE PLAYING[/b]:

[b]New Weapons[/b]:[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/d44cbb116546ad3456a484a0f4bb2a26607d84d8.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Desert Eagle[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/8a68be683a2c2a6713622c940e020c45a7b7ef1c.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/aa3fbde23c46769f9c5ec113cb7d2ec74da1fa5b.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/151c221a7255dc8d84251de2aca3a80e49322dcf.gif[/img]
Our latest pistol the Desert Eagle, provides higher damage per shot, with a trade-off of higher recoil and a smaller magazine.  The pistol will be available for selection upon death in the weapons selection menu or picked up in the Wasteland during survival mode

[*] [b]Katana[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/e792935a9ca7aeafe46f902d3c4996872a2a206d.gif[/img]
Due to popular demand, we added the much wanted Katana blade. The Katana is located behind your back. Reach over either shoulder to bring it out! You may slash and stab the enemy or dual wield it while holding the combat knife as well. Use two handed grip for added stability!

[*] [b]Pump Action Shotgun[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/f94da184085286c7e215bd5017bb7a4d3197cb8a.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/004d1ab70a97b623204b7d1ae1603022b9ed0bf3.gif[/img]
The Shotgun adds a new dynamic to AMF VR and is very useful for room clearing and spread shots. You may select it in the starting room or weapons menu when you die. Pump each time you shoot by using your off hand on the front grip and holding down the trigger while pulling back. Reloading is done by loading the shells in one at a time, with a maximum of 8 shots. Lock n load! 
 [/list]

[b]NEW MAP: Wasteland[/b]
[list][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/49c654e107c6df228f1d772bc88e7835e3f73728.jpg[/img]
Wasteland is a larger sized Post-Apocalyptic map with many buildings and uneven terrain for you to mix up your combat style in. The map can be played in Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch as well as our newest campaign mode: Survival. Come check it out today! [/list]

[b]NEW CAMPAIGN: SURVIVAL[/b][list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/434e6fedd8a49bee0d0f76ed3a461d40e274b613.jpg[/img]
Survival is our newest Campaign mode for AMF VR and may have up to a team of 4 playing at the same time. The rules are simple:
[*]You have one life
[*]Survive for 10 minutes and scour for weapons on the battlefield
[*]Make it to the rescue helicopter. The chopper will appear once the 10 minutes is up. Be aware that it will appear at a random location each time.

[b]Survival Mode Guide[/b]
Welcome to the Wasteland
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/e0759ac0f01b2c0a76dcf94921f3e26f37337559.jpg[/img]

The Survival Campaign may be selected from the host menu in the lobby
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/f7dd7296d3f261e7e64a7f412562b500615ef0c3.jpg[/img]

Once you enter the Wasteland, remember to press START once you are ready or when all your teammates have arrived. You may check the mission guidelines by pressing your watch on your left hand:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/79c3bc270707804a37f390254c6311a1a462c49a.jpg[/img]

Starting out, you will have a Pistol, Katana and Combat Knife. Scour the landscape to find additional weapons. Be sure to conserve your ammo as it is limited and specific to each weapon acquired
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/2a73e8c6cb06c3dcae66909481871f333d476605.jpg[/img]

Killing enemies also allows you to pick up their weapon:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/2d9a6989e22a5e068813d0e96c958c1c9ed1ec28.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/39a59dce822cb6a16d33b87d19ae789e9719b0c8.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/a6a4f34f7d83de9b868406510f3694e8c82a7db7.jpg[/img]

You may revive your teammates if they are down by standing in the white circle for 5 seconds. If all members of your team die, the game is over
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/c005231d9242e06064c0b2d352569bfc61a75e74.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/0b271575f885071165baa123de5b3300090b2bae.jpg[/img]

Survive for 10 minutes and wait for the helicopter to arrive. Make your approach carefully for a successful extraction. Only one member needs to reach the helicopter to complete the mission.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/c6d59ee5bf847b6c72643c0ba135860c01c93006.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/40154b4017e16a72ca7e5d0c7b040451768b6b9f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/bd7fbd9cace68d585780f2cf927087d50a0ddf52.jpg[/img]

Congratulations, you have completed the Survival Campaign!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/a3b7deabeda4944da5c6d31d8da22bb0ba2cf62a.jpg[/img]
[/list]

We hope you enjoy our latest update and make it to the top of the leaderboards!

Stay up to date with the latest news, communicate with the AMF community and be part of the VR FPS revolution by joining our Discord: 
https://discordapp.com/invite/5mdwNsD

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/506a591d354b981ece5f178ddd4fc83429bacd14.png[/img]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #3 - Co-op Campaign Mode: Operation Frontal Assault + Add Friends Ingame + Private Games
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Merry Christmas!!  The AMF Team has been hard at work these few weeks to bring you an all NEW GAME MODE and major feature updates

[b]PLEASE RELOAD STEAM & DOWNLOAD THE LATEST AMF VR UPDATE BEFORE PLAYING[/b] Ver 0.80

[b]OPERATION: FRONTAL ASSAULT[/b]
Welcome to our first Co-op Campaign Mission it is suggested to have at least 2 players to complete it, with a maximum of 4. Select the "Enclave" Map to start the challenge. [b]Operation: Frontal Assault[/b] features a massive map needing to complete 3 objectives. Your team has 30 lives to complete the Campaign, here is your mission guide:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/bbb8b83e2f7a950d49fdae53630b7fa4222af867.jpg[/img]

[u][b]START[/b][/u]
You will start on a boat, please invite team members here or wait for players to join before pressing START. You may also go solo and invite players to join mid game. You may go Solo, but it will be extremely challenging.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/882ab19e39b57700e493b7686ea9bb7a40800f37.jpg[/img]

[u][b]OBJECTIVE A[/b][/u]: Find the Code, Open the Gate
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/07483d98dec0e697a198e9220b389c3bcae1e702.jpg[/img]
The code is in any 1 of the 4 container houses located on the edges of the map. Check your mission guide using the panel on your left hand for the locations.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/5a9b01437d96aad7fd0a31e287e5f41826103e1b.jpg[/img]
Search the table for the code, it could be hidden under an item:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/545215d21756181ce8ce32deb45b501403dbe45a.jpg[/img]
Make it to the gate and enter the code to get to the next stage, don't forget to pickup the shield before moving on!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/03528ec9e16be63ceb441ab04714f8ff95c0068d.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/6504a2b972e954f4b92d1c4fa44642ebcea7ea79.jpg[/img]
[b]OBJECTIVE A Hint[/b]: Clear out all the towers using the sniper rifle before proceeding to search for the code
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/c8a0d38ef1e82c3038fc7b222887e00250c305f0.jpg[/img]

[u][b]OBJECTIVE B[/b][/u]: Capture 3 checkpoints
Fight your way down the highway and capture 3 checkpoints along the way. Be careful and always watch your back!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/a6495ca55f5781d621d95db494cc6126b548756e.jpg[/img]
When Standing in the circle you will capture each check point. There are a total of 3.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/17c2e943fdab882ad4fa087c1e1c74209a768ef2.jpg[/img]
[b]OBJECTIVE B Hint[/b]: At Checkpoint 1, you have an opportunity to reload your grenades and knifes once the point is captured.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/1da323219d728583cbe9b8d01bd9ae8c7c70b3b8.jpg[/img]

[u][b]OBJECTIVE C[/b][/u]: Escort the Tank to the Airstrip and Escape! BEWARE: BOSS BOTS!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/06278fa4d32265b005cf3ef3e3880bd19b494364.jpg[/img]
This massive base is split into two sections. Fight your way through the enemy's main military complex and reach the tank located in the industrial section of the map.  You may look at your left hand for an arrow pointing towards where the tank is parked. (The tank is parked under the sky bridge).
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/5a85c56ae7bfd4cd515cebfdf2452ce061f4de70.jpg[/img]
Stand within the Yellow Circle and escort the tank to the airstrip. As long as you are in the Yellow Circle the tank will move towards its destination automatically.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/aa9dadf5268b9697bc6881cead0343b398a6a931.jpg[/img]
Upon reaching the last part of the Escort mission, your rescue helicopter will fly towards the airstrip. Make sure the tank destroys the last gate in order to make it to safety!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/924e95b03e1554816d2b07890ea70cad6ef738fd.jpg[/img]
[b]OBJECTIVE C[/b] Hint: When trying to reach the tank, run round the edge of the map, use cover to avoid enemy detection. Either breach the main entrance on the left of go over the sky bridge on the right.

Challenge the leaderboard for the best completion time. 
GOOD LUCK!! :D
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/8da5e686a26fe946fd5f0412cedd7b3a9e5b61ae.jpg[/img]


OTHER BIG UPDATES:
[u][b]Framework[/b][/u][list]
[*]Added function to add friends on Steam directly from the Scoreboard. When playing, open the scoreboard and there will be a man icon next to their name. If it is White: They are your friend, Green with + symbol, you may click on it to invite them to be your steam friend! 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/922c31d21f18f9e4072165eacadc2258aa973ff7.png[/img]
If someone sends you a friend invite you will see a man icon pop up in your menu system, click on it and accept the invite to be friends :)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/dcaf7fd7708086f3b8cf1f22288965db203526c0.png[/img]
[*]Brand new friends menu in the lobby and in game. See which of your friends are in game, and on which server
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/3335d336f36a0f7b606f681431767295f60f3111.png[/img]
[*]Added function to invite friends to join your game, open your menu system in game and press the "3 heads" button to open the friends menu.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/63d879a02bf1a4dd6f59335f9e63b16dc5a0d6f9.png[/img]
 From here you can invite a friend to join a game. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/9b8c4cfc773b943f48c50d87dc9088e1ded32e85.png[/img]
If you friend is in the lobby, he will see a door next to your name and room number on the friends list. Click the door and enter the game.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/d55082846664ff7afa978832d5e599702fb4959f.png[/img]
[*]Added function to lock you game for single player which includes invite friends only when locked. This can be done in the lobby or in game.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/70712d03f68c4cdea859d196459a86fad327180d.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/77df4de5be1c78967c45199b531ae8f2ae85d8dc.jpg[/img]
[*]Brand new weapons selection menu using gaze and trigger
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/13d4df2cfb7125cdd917eef28693126373f73324.png[/img][/list]

Hope Everyone has a Merry Christmas and enjoy the new game mode and features!

Need Teammates for Operation Frontal Assault? Stay up to date with the latest news, communicate with the AMF community and be part of the VR FPS revolution by joining our Discord: 
https://discordapp.com/invite/5mdwNsD

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/717f947e3c451704f6701b96554a25693c37e4d5.jpg[/img]

[u][b]START[/b][/u]
You will start on a boat, please invite team members here or wait for players to join before pressing START. You may also go solo and invite players to join mid game. You may go Solo, but it will be extremely challenging.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/882ab19e39b57700e493b7686ea9bb7a40800f37.jpg[/img]

[u][b]OBJECTIVE A[/b][/u]: Find the Code, Open the Gate
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/07483d98dec0e697a198e9220b389c3bcae1e702.jpg[/img]
The code is in any 1 of the 4 container houses located on the edges of the map. Check your mission guide using the panel on your left hand for the locations.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/5a9b01437d96aad7fd0a31e287e5f41826103e1b.jpg[/img]
Search the table for the code, it could be hidden under an item:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/545215d21756181ce8ce32deb45b501403dbe45a.jpg[/img]
Make it to the gate and enter the code to get to the next stage, don't forget to pickup the shield before moving on!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/03528ec9e16be63ceb441ab04714f8ff95c0068d.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/6504a2b972e954f4b92d1c4fa44642ebcea7ea79.jpg[/img]
[b]OBJECTIVE A Hint[/b]: Clear out all the towers using the sniper rifle before proceeding to search for the code
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/c8a0d38ef1e82c3038fc7b222887e00250c305f0.jpg[/img]

[u][b]OBJECTIVE B[/b][/u]: Capture 3 checkpoints
Fight your way down the highway and capture 3 checkpoints along the way. Be careful and always watch your back!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/a6495ca55f5781d621d95db494cc6126b548756e.jpg[/img]
When Standing in the circle you will capture each check point. There are a total of 3.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/17c2e943fdab882ad4fa087c1e1c74209a768ef2.jpg[/img]
[b]OBJECTIVE B Hint[/b]: At Checkpoint 1, you have an opportunity to reload your grenades and knifes once the point is captured.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/1da323219d728583cbe9b8d01bd9ae8c7c70b3b8.jpg[/img]

[u][b]OBJECTIVE C[/b][/u]: Escort the Tank to the Airstrip and Escape! BEWARE: BOSS BOTS!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/06278fa4d32265b005cf3ef3e3880bd19b494364.jpg[/img]
This massive base is split into two sections. Fight your way through the enemy's main military complex and reach the tank located in the industrial section of the map.  You may look at your left hand for an arrow pointing towards where the tank is parked. (The tank is parked under the sky bridge).
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/5a85c56ae7bfd4cd515cebfdf2452ce061f4de70.jpg[/img]
Stand within the Yellow Circle and escort the tank to the airstrip. As long as you are in the Yellow Circle the tank will move towards its destination automatically.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/aa9dadf5268b9697bc6881cead0343b398a6a931.jpg[/img]
Upon reaching the last part of the Escort mission, your rescue helicopter will fly towards the airstrip. Make sure the tank destroys the last gate in order to make it to safety!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/924e95b03e1554816d2b07890ea70cad6ef738fd.jpg[/img]
[b]OBJECTIVE C[/b] Hint: When trying to reach the tank, run round the edge of the map, use cover to avoid enemy detection. Either breach the main entrance on the left of go over the sky bridge on the right.

Challenge the leaderboard for the best completion time. 
GOOD LUCK!! :D
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/8da5e686a26fe946fd5f0412cedd7b3a9e5b61ae.jpg[/img]

[*]Added function to add friends on Steam directly from the Scoreboard. When playing, open the scoreboard and there will be a man icon next to their name. If it is White: They are your friend, Green with + symbol, you may click on it to invite them to be your steam friend! 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/922c31d21f18f9e4072165eacadc2258aa973ff7.png[/img]
If someone sends you a friend invite you will see a man icon pop up in your menu system, click on it and accept the invite to be friends :)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/dcaf7fd7708086f3b8cf1f22288965db203526c0.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/3335d336f36a0f7b606f681431767295f60f3111.png[/img]

 From here you can invite a friend to join a game. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/9b8c4cfc773b943f48c50d87dc9088e1ded32e85.png[/img]
If you friend is in the lobby, he will see a door next to your name and room number on the friends list. Click the door and enter the game.

notes.notes:
Hi Guys,

This is the Early Access HOTFIX 1 to address some of the issues found during our first 24 hours of release on Early Access.

[u]PLEASE RELOAD STEAM[/u], then download the latest AMF VR Update!

[b]EARLY ACCESS PATCH 1[/b][list][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/7b8f5c6d06bd556f51a8d4e14934017b07ed1934.jpg[/img]
[*]OCULUS CONTROLS MAJOR UPDATE, the controls should now feel natural and intuitive and equal to the HTC Vive control scheme 
[*]Bots bugging out on Dock map fixed
[*]Auto refresh function for games in play. No need to pound the refresh button anymore :)
[*]Bug for not being able to exit the victory room on some maps fixed
Game guide updated to reflect the new Oculus Touch controls [/list]

=====================================================


We wanted to address a few common questions from new users:

[b]FAQ[/b]:
[b]Q1[/b]: Why is the menu always off screen or blocking my view?
[b]A1[/b]: AMF has an intuitive Menu System.
Press the Menu button (Y or B on Oculus) on either controller to Open. 
Hold down TRIGGER on the Globe to move Menu Location.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/13d1d627010ebcaf34d3bfcae7121b88644ac98f.gif[/img]

[b]Q2[/b]: The background music is annoying
[b]A2[/b]: You may turn off the background music in the in-game menu system under "BGM"[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/2321d39ef051f405289f34bb5ba9ef16cbe2901c.gif[/img]

[b]Q3[/b]: The Oculus controls don't seem to work
[b]A3[/b]: The Oculus controls have been patched to match the Vive Controls. Please update the game to its' newest release, please see game guide for details: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1139258639

[b]Q3[/b]: Why do I keep losing tracking when playing AMF using Oculus?
[b]A4[/b]: Currently AMF only supports 360 tracking and 3 sensors are required. This is stated in the game requirements. for 2 sensor users we strongly recommend putting one sensor in the front and one in the back, we plan to add snap turning in a future update.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/de1403d3ef821ebcb3d85ac1fa76bc18080feb6f.jpg[/img]

Added AI Bots (Version 0.10) - Due to popular demand through the survey results, bots was the top requested feature you wanted included in AMF, so here you go!

1) Start a game using the “Classic” (All Weapons) Game play mode with 2, 4, 6 or 8 players either TDM or DM
2) Bots will spawn accordingly once the game starts by pulling both triggers with the menu open. Players are still free to chat and wait for other players without the bots before then.
3) If a new player hops into the server, one of the bots will be replaced.

[*]Bots are currently available on ALL maps except for Dock, Ruins and Dugouts.

[*]The difficulty level is set to “Standard”, different levels will be coming soon.
[*]Look forward to more bot features as we continue to make the game better![/list]

[b]Framework[/b]:[list]
[*]Further increased network stability for login and reduced chance of dropout during games
[*]Fixed Respawning issue in Prison and Dock maps
